channel.title: Onchain Brief
channel.description: Crypto news on Bitcoin, Ethereum, DeFi, stablecoins, exchanges, wallets, security incidents, regulation and new blockchain networks.

item.title: FBI links North Korea to $6.3bn Binance theft
item.description: The FBI says North Korea stole over $6 billion from Binance on Oct. 29, naming TraderTraitor as it urges crypto firms to block the stolen funds.

item.title: Chainalysis breach exposed hashes and live tokens across user base
item.description: Chainalysis says names, usernames, password hashes and live tokens were exposed, prompting resets as services return under tighter access controls.

item.title: Binance says fake job interview led to $6.34 billion hack
item.description: Binance says a fake recruitment process helped hackers reach its wallet systems before a $6.34 billion theft, with most affected tokens since replenished.

item.title: What a Fraxswap LP token really represents
item.description: A Fraxswap LP token represents a share of a pool’s changing reserves, not a fixed amount of either token. Here is how deposits and withdrawals work.

item.title: Bitcoin tops $80,000 as Zcash gains nearly 12%
item.description: Bitcoin traded near $80,484 and Zcash gained 11.7% as crypto prices rebounded after Democrats won both houses, while traders weighed policy risks.

item.title: Can one EigenLayer service slash your whole stake?
item.description: One EigenLayer service can slash the stake assigned to it, but the risk depends on how much an operator allocates and what the service’s rules allow.

item.title: Bitcoin rebounds after midterm dip as Binance hack weighs
item.description: Bitcoin briefly hit a six-week low after Democrats took Congress, then recovered as stocks turned higher; Binance’s $6.3 billion hack kept pressure on confidence.

item.title: Binance says fake job interview aided $6.3B hack
item.description: Binance says a fake interview helped hackers reach its wallets before a $6.34 billion theft; it has frozen $2.85 billion, and its investigation is ongoing.

item.title: Should You Withdraw From a Classic Pool or Stay In?
item.description: Classic Pool LPs should stay only if swap fees justify the changing token mix and they still want exposure; otherwise, withdrawing resets the decision.

item.title: FBI links $6 billion Binance theft to North Korea
item.description: The FBI says North Korean hackers stole more than $6 billion from Binance, and is urging crypto firms to block wallets as investigators track the funds.

item.title: Hackers steal $6.3 billion from Binance; exchange covers 90%
item.description: Hackers stole about $6.3 billion from Binance in late October; the exchange says it has restored 90% of affected assets and will cover users’ losses.

item.title: Binance starts phased withdrawals after $6.3bn hack
item.description: Binance began reopening withdrawals in phases on Sunday after a security breach it puts at about $6.3 billion, while saying users will not bear the losses.

item.title: FBI links $6bn Binance theft to North Korean hackers
item.description: The FBI says North Korea stole more than $6 billion from Binance and urges crypto firms to block wallets as the stolen funds move toward laundering.

item.title: Binance says it has covered 90% of losses from $6.3B hack
item.description: Binance says it has covered 90% of losses from a $6.3 billion hack, but withdrawals remain paused as it works to cover the rest and investigate the breach.

item.title: Hackers steal $6.3 billion from Binance wallets
item.description: Binance says hackers took about $6.3 billion from its hot wallets, and it will cover the loss as investigators trace funds across ten blockchains.

item.title: Binance says security incident affected about $6.3 billion
item.description: Binance says a security incident may have enabled unauthorized withdrawals worth about $6.3 billion; roughly $3 billion is frozen as withdrawals stay paused.

item.title: Analysts link $6.3 billion Binance theft to North Korea
item.description: Blockchain firms say North Korea-linked hackers likely stole $6.3 billion from Binance; the exchange says it froze about $3 billion and is recovering assets.

item.title: Ripple says OCC gives final approval to trust bank
item.description: Ripple says the OCC has given its national trust bank final approval, adding federal oversight around RLUSD reserves while issuance stays with its New York trust company.

item.title: Coinbase adds Ripple’s RLUSD stablecoin to three platforms
item.description: Coinbase has added Ripple’s RLUSD to its retail app, Exchange and Prime, with one-for-one dollar conversions and transfers on three networks; Global Exchange access will follow.

item.title: OCC rule leaves crypto platforms free to offer stablecoin rewards
item.description: The OCC's stablecoin rule leaves crypto platforms able to offer rewards tied to stablecoin balances, while issuers remain barred from paying holders directly under federal law.
